title: Adaptive mini‑guides: compact usage cards for tokens, controls, tables, charts
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a collection of compact, scannable 'mini‑guides' (card-sized docs) that live on the docsite and in Figma to help engineers and designers quickly choose token variants, button styles, table density options, and chart responsiveness. These guides focus on: 1) one‑sentence intent, 2) short do / don't bullets, 3) a tiny code snippet (1–2 lines), and 4) migration note when replacing legacy classes. Goal is to reduce back-and-forth and speed adoption for small teams integrating components without reading the full API reference.
acceptance_criteria: Eight mini‑guide cards published on docsite: Tokens (color/intent), Spacing & scale, Primary/Secondary button, Compact table row, Comfortable table row, Dense chart variant, Time‑series chart mobile rule, Legend placement quicktip.
Each card includes: intent (<=1 sentence), 2 do/don't bullets, 1 compact code snippet, accessibility note, and migration snippet for legacy class names.
Figma file artboard with each mini‑card created and linked from docsite.
Docs links to corresponding API pages and example Storybook stories; automated redirects or banners added for teams using deprecated tokens.
Peer review from PM (Jules Ortega) and Engineering lead (Hannah Lee) recorded and addressed in comments.
One small A/B test run in docs: track clicks on mini‑guides vs full docs for two weeks (analytics event: docs.mini_guide_click).
migration_notes: Color tokens: map legacy tokens like --color-primary-old to new semantic tokens (surface.primary, action.primary) — include one line CSS custom property mapping.
Buttons: show quick class rename example: btn--primary -> <Button variant="primary"> and include React import snippet.
Tables: recommend replacing .table-compact with <Table density="compact"> and include note about rowKey prop change.
Charts: legacy chart options (responsive: false) -> set responsivePreset="mobile-friendly" and note chart legend repositioning default.
Add migration banner in related API pages for 3 months after rollout with link to migration checklist.
examples: Token card (color): Intent: 'Surface and accents should express intent, not brand.' Do: use semantic tokens; Don't: hardcode hex in components. Example: style={{ background: 'var(--surface-primary)' }}.
Button card: Do: prefer <Button variant="primary"> for high‑impact CTAs; Don't: combine iconOnly + primary for critical actions. Example: <Button variant="primary">Deploy</Button>.
Table card: For dense data grids use density="compact" to enable tighter row padding. Example: <Table density="compact" />. Accessibility: ensure row highlight visible at 2.5:1 contrast.
Chart card: On narrow viewports, switch to simplified axis ticks (ticks="sparse") and hide gridlines for readability. Example props: <LineChart responsivePreset="mobile-friendly" ticks="sparse" />
